comment: The iron_gauntlets, a WORN piece: one shell per covered limb, each of which becomes a real rig slot on the wearer and therefore burns, dissolves, carves, severs and drops exactly as a limb does. Geometry is the stock human's own silhouette dilated outward by one authored micro, so it fits by construction. Regenerate with scripts/gen_stock_armor.py — `offset` and `fitBox` are MEASURED off gen_human.py's limb table, so editing them by hand puts the garment off the body.
name: iron_gauntlets
